fields.climate: tropical maritime; little seasonal temperature variation; seasonal variation in rainfall
fields.terrain: rugged highlands and mountains interspersed with fertile valleys
fields.hazards: lies in the middle of the hurricane belt and subject to severe storms from June to October; occasional flooding; periodic droughts
fields.resources: nickel, bauxite, gold, silver, arable land
fields.farm: sugarcane, bananas, papayas, plantains, avocados, rice, milk, watermelons, vegetables, pineapples
fields.exports: medical instruments, tobacco, gold, garments, power equipment
fields.industries: tourism, sugar processing, gold mining, textiles, cement, tobacco, electrical components, medical devices
fields.legal: civil law system based on the French civil code; Criminal Procedures Code modified in 2004 to include important elements of an accusatory system
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory; married persons can vote, regardless of age
fields.military: 17-early 20s for voluntary military service for men and women (ages vary depending on military service and position; under 18 admitted with permission of parents)
